node.title: SOV first-obstruction coefficient sensitivity
node.statement: For the forced-root obstruction construction, changing only the coefficient of X^{h-1} in the locator L leaves the forced root unchanged and changes the first obstruction O_{h-1} by exactly the negative of that coefficient change. Hence O_{h-1} is the correct coordinate-sensitive obstruction to use for the value-set problem.
node.attack_surface: triangular forced-root recursion and coefficient inspection
node.falsifier: a unit change in the X^{h-1} coefficient that changes the forced root or fails to change O_{h-1} by -1
